Folio — the curated theme set

Home regenerated per theme from the six swatches each face authors. Nine families × two separately painted faces = eighteen faces, no two of which share a palette.

Applied in this build: the plate's three hues are chosen for separation rather than list order (abyss dark: 183/195/290, 13° apart, → 183/290/34, 104° apart) and the renderer draws all three instead of one; the light plate is deepened 0.30 toward the ink; the crown is a gradient band with the name reversed out, deepened hard on paper (0.12–0.48) and only at the foot on ink (0.02–0.40) because darkening a luminous signature on a near-black page costs the very contrast the crown is for; the nav capsule wears the crown's colour so the two ends of the screen agree; the dark floor went 0.32 → 0.62; and the hero pane on a dark face 0.46 → 0.62.

build marker: masthead — if you cannot see the wordmark in colour on the Home sheets, you are looking at a cached copy.
